categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Zeyu Intelligent Electric Power Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electric power information industry, offering integrated intelligent power grid services. Its main business segments include power system consulting and design, system integration (covering power communication systems, new power system-related business, and intelligent power operation and maintenance systems), and engineering construction and operation & maintenance services. The company serves the entire power system chain including generation, transmission, distribution, transformation, consumption, and dispatching.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as optical transport networks (OTN), synchronous digital hierarchy (SDH), XPON fiber access, 4G/5G integrated communication terminals, AI-powered edge computing gateways, big data analytics, cloud computing, IoT, and AI algorithms for power system monitoring and control. It develops proprietary communication boards, digital twin-based optical fiber distribution robots, intelligent inspection robots, and microgrid energy management systems. The production methods emphasize system integration, customized R&D, and deployment of hardware and software solutions tailored to power grid needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are state-owned power grid companies, power generation groups, and end users within the electric power sector, including national and regional grid operators such as State Grid Corporation of China. It also serves industrial, commercial, and residential users requiring power infrastructure and smart grid solutions. The major market is the electric power industry in China, focusing on smart grid construction, new energy integration, and digital transformation of power systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: Jiangsu Zeyu Intelligent Electric Power Co., Ltd. operates mainly in China with significant business in Jiangsu Province, Anhui Province, Beijing, Shanghai, Qinghai Province, and other regions. It has established sales divisions covering East China, South China, and North China, aiming to expand nationwide. The company also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and other provinces, supporting its geographic diversification.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric power supply chain, focusing on system integration, engineering construction, and operation & maintenance services. It acts as a solution provider integrating communication equipment, software, and intelligent devices into power grid infrastructure, rather than upstream manufacturing of raw materials or generation of electricity.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes R&D in intelligent power grids, digital transformation, and new energy integration. Key R&D directions include AI-enhanced inspection algorithms, 4/5G integrated communication devices, digital twin technology for optical fiber management, microgrid energy management systems, and intelligent inspection robots. The company emphasizes developing proprietary, domestically controlled communication hardware to enhance supply chain stability and market competitiveness. It also focuses on expanding one-stop smart grid service capabilities and advancing digital power plant platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated system solutions, engineering construction contracts, and operation & maintenance services. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and acceptance of products and services, mainly via project bidding and direct negotiation with power grid clients. It also earns income from consulting, customized R&D services, and financial investments related to idle funds management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both internal power system research institutes and external specialized firms in the power information sector, such as China Electric Power Research Institute, Guodian Nari Technology, Guodian Nanjing Automation, Shenzhen Hailianxun Technology, and Jiangsu Jinzhi Technology. It holds a strong regional position in Jiangsu and is recognized for its comprehensive one-stop smart grid services and innovative R&D capabilities, though the market remains fragmented without dominant monopolies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.35 billion, a 27% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 218 million, a 15% decrease from the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 3.37 billion, growing 5.5% from 2023. The company has shown steady revenue growth driven by system integration services, while net profit declined due to increased costs and investments. It maintains a solid asset base and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with a 5.2% revenue ratio allocated to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its one-stop integrated smart grid service capability, covering consulting, design, system integration, construction, and operation & maintenance, providing tailored solutions that enhance power grid efficiency, reliability, and intelligence. Its proprietary technologies in AI, 4/5G communication, digital twin, and intelligent inspection robots differentiate it from competitors. The focus on domestic control of core communication hardware and deep integration with national grid strategies enhances its competitive edge and supply chain stability. The company also leverages strong customer relationships, especially with State Grid, and regional expertise in Jiangsu to maintain market leadership.
